description.en:
CASBOT 01 is a full-size bipedal humanoid presented by CASBOT at CES 2025. Nicknamed Wednesday, it combines articulated legs, dexterous hands and a sensor-equipped head for movement, manipulation and visual-auditory interaction. The company positions it as a platform for exploring varied physical tasks.

Its launch specification lists a height of 1.79 metres, weight of 60 kg and 52 degrees of freedom. CASBOT describes dynamic force control and examples including handling clothing, assembling a lamp and turning screws. These are manufacturer-reported capabilities of CASBOT 01, distinct from the later CASBOT 02 configuration.
